QuestInfo.name: Jane and the Wild Boar
QuestInfo.0: Look for Jane in Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.1: In Lith Harbor, you find Jane, a girl wearing bunny ears. Jane says she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if you can get her #b10 Wild Boar Teeth and 10 Horny Mushroom Caps#k, her father will change his mind.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t4000020# and #t4000015##k to Jane. You wonder if this will really change her father's mind...she's wearing bunny ears, for goodness sake! Ah well, it's none of your business. In return, Jane gave you a Scroll for ATT. Your weapon's going to be awesome...if the Scroll works.

0.0: My dream is to travel freely around the world, just like you! But, argh, my dad won't let me. I tell him I'm ready to spread my wings a little, but he just won't listen.
0.1: Hmm. You look pretty strong. Can...can I ask you a favor? Please bring me #e10#n #bWild Boar Teeth#k and #e10#n #b#t4000015#s#k. If you can do this for me, my father might give me permission to travel the world. Please, I'm begging you...
0.2: A #t4000020# looks like #i4000020# and a #t4000015# looks like #i4000015#. You can get them from #o2230102# and #o2110200#. Oooh, I'm so excited about this!

1.0: Incredible! You got so many #o2230102#s and #o2110200#s! Now I can prove to my dad that I'm strong enough to travel by myself! Hehehe! What? It's not dishonest... I could've done it on my own, but I didn't want to leave town behind my dad's back...
1.1: It's none of your business anyway. Here, just take your reward and don't ask so many questions.

yes.0: This scroll can strengthen a certain weapon. Just open the Use tab of your Item Inventory and open your Equipment Inventory at the same time, then drag the scroll onto the weapon. There's a chance the scroll will fail, but life's risky like that...

item.0: If you can just bring me #e10#n #bWild Boar Teeth#k and #e10#n #b#t4000015#s#k, I'll finally be able to start traveling... I'm begging you.
